metadata.title: Dali Bathwn | Red Lentil Chutney | Bodo Recipe
metadata.description:
I got this recipe from one of my long time subscriber Mr. Dhanalal Musahary. I thought this would be another chutney recipe, but I was proven wrong and this recipe actually made me realize that food and memories go hand in hand. The moment I tasted this chutney it took me to a small town hotel near my village. They serve this Bodo thaali and this particular chutney is always there in that platter. This is delicious umami tasting chutney with a slight pungent hit of mustard oil, what a delicate balance of flavour. You should try this at home. 

Ingredients required
1/4 cup Red lentils
4 cloves of Garlic
1 inch piece of ginger
2 tbsp mustard oil
Coriander leaves
Spring Onions
Salt to taste
